marketInfo.assetDescription:
hyWHYPE is a pool from HypurrFi, a lending protocol on HyperEVM that allows users to earn interest by lending WHYPE onto the isolated pool with mHYPE. By lending WHYPE into this isolated pool, users can borrow WHYPE by using mHYPE as collateral. Refer here for more information on the isolated pool.

Supply APY of this pool is based on the utilization rate of WHYPE borrows against mHYPE.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
Yields can go negative on these conditions:

  • Bad Debt: If the liquidation of a borrower's collateral fails to cover the full value of the borrowed WHYPE, the protocol incurs a loss. This \bad debt\" is socialized among the lenders in the pool.
  • Oracle Price Manipulation: If the price oracle used to value collateral is manipulated or fails. (from underlying protocol)

marketInfo.assetDescription:
NVDA is a Stock Token issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited, giving economic exposure to NVIDIA Corporation shares on Robinhood Chain. Each token is backed 1:1 by underlying shares held with a licensed custodian and monitored daily, and is accessible around the clock.

Yield comes from the company's dividends that applied onchain through a multiplier that adjusts the shares-per-token ratio.

At maturity:

PT redeems for one NVIDIA share's worth of NVDA. Because the multiplier raises the shares behind each token over time, this settles as slightly less than one whole NVDA token.

YT collects the dividends paid to one NVIDIA share over the life of the market.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Issuer credit risk: Stock Tokens are tokenised debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited. A holder's claim is against the issuer, with no legal or beneficial rights in, or against the issuer of, the underlying shares.
  • Dividend risk: yield depends entirely on the company continuing to declare dividends. Dividend policy can be cut or suspended at any time, and realised yield would fall to zero.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
sNET is the yield-bearing staked version of NET from NetNet Capital. Every NET is backed by at least 1 USDG of risk-free reserves. Yield accrues through a permissionless dividend program that mints new NET each 8-hour epoch (three distributions per day).

The dividend rate follows a fixed formula based on NET's market price relative to NAV: zero when NET trades at or below NAV, scaling linearly to a maximum of 0.45% per epoch at a 1.75× premium. This policy cannot be modified by governance. Refer to the NetNet mechanism docs for the full breakdown.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Zero-yield periods: Dividends are 0 whenever NET trades at or below NAV. Realised APY depends entirely on sustained market premium.
  • Dilution risk: Management holds a perpetually renewable option to mint up to 15% of circulating supply at 1 USDG per NET, creating ongoing NAV drag.
  • Counterparty risk: Up to 70% of reserves are deployed to Morpho — smart contract failures or liquidity events at Morpho could impact the backing.
  • Custody risk: The guardian key is controlled by a 1-of-1 Safe (management-controlled), not a multi-sig.
  • No governance escape hatch: The protocol cannot pause, patch bugs, or adjust parameters — formulas execute identically regardless of market conditions.

(From Underlying Protocol here)

SHROOM is a fixed-supply token on Robinhood Chain that operates as a liquidity layer for tokenised stocks. It deploys protocol-owned pools pairing SHROOM against stock tokens, routes trades between them, and autocompounds the fees it earns back into those pools to deepen liquidity.

Yield comes from trading activity. Holders receive periodic rewards paid in $MU, the tokenised Micron Technology stock SHROOM is paired against, so YT accrues $MU rather than more SHROOM.
marketInfo.riskInvolved: • Fee-dependent yield: the payout is a share of trading fees and scales with volume alone. If trading dries up, yield goes to zero.
marketInfo.importantQuirks:
• Generated yield: Yield is paid in MU, not in SHROOM.
  • Minimum payout size: Pons skips any address owed under $1.50 in a payout round (~every 45 min). The SY is one address, so the pool's combined balance must clear that line, not your own deposit — and accrual resumes on its own once it does.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
sNUKE is the rebasing staked version of NUKE from NUKES.FUN, a treasury protocol on Robinhood Chain whose stated goal is to accumulate Nano Nuclear Energy (NASDAQ: NNE) stock. NUKE is acquired on the open market or by bonding USDG at a discount with a five-day linear vest, and each NUKE is backed by a share of the protocol treasury.

Staking NUKE mints sNUKE, which rebases every eight hours — three times per day — as newly issued NUKE is distributed to stakers and compounds automatically. The treasury acquires NNE through OTC execution with an Authorized Participant able to mint NNE stock tokens directly, rather than buying them on the open market. See the NUKES.FUN protocol manual for the full design.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Emission-funded yield: the staking APY is paid in newly minted NUKE, not external revenue. It is a dilution split between stakers and non-stakers, so a high headline APY does not by itself imply a gain in value — backing per NUKE is what matters.
  • Single-asset treasury: backing is concentrated in one small-cap NASDAQ equity. A drawdown in NNE passes straight through to NUKE's backing.
  • Tokenized-equity counterparty risk: NNE exposure is held as stock tokens minted by an Authorized Participant. Mint and redemption depend on that party and the issuer, and the token can dislocate from the underlying share price outside US market hours.
  • No shareholder rights: NUKE and sNUKE confer no ownership or shareholder rights in NNE.
  • Team issuance: an Incentives Bond activates above a $33M NUKE market cap, with cumulative issuance capped at 10% of NUKE supply.
  • New protocol, thin liquidity: NUKE trades in a single protocol-owned NUKE/USDG concentrated-liquidity pool on GigaDEX; protocol-owned positions sit behind a multisig and timelock.

(From Underlying Protocol here)
marketInfo.importantQuirks: Bonded NUKE vests linearly over five days; there is no instant native mint of NUKE from USDG at par.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
PFE is a Stock Token issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited, giving economic exposure to Pfizer Inc. shares on Robinhood Chain. Each token is backed 1:1 by underlying shares held with a licensed custodian and monitored daily, and is accessible around the clock.

Yield comes from the company's dividends. Corporate actions are applied onchain through a multiplier that adjusts the shares-per-token ratio.

At maturity:

PT redeems for one PFIZER share's worth of PFE. Because the multiplier raises the shares behind each token over time, this settles as slightly less than one whole PFE token.

YT collects the dividends paid to one PFIZER share over the life of the market.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Issuer credit risk: Stock Tokens are tokenised debt securities issued by Robinhood Assets (Jersey) Limited. A holder's claim is against the issuer, with no legal or beneficial rights in, or against the issuer of, the underlying shares.
  • Dividend risk: yield depends entirely on the company continuing to declare dividends. Dividend policy can be cut or suspended at any time, and realised yield would fall to zero.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
sNET is the yield-bearing staked version of NET from NetNet Capital. Every NET is backed by at least 1 USDG of risk-free reserves. Yield accrues through a permissionless dividend program that mints new NET each 8-hour epoch (three distributions per day).

The dividend rate follows a fixed formula based on NET's market price relative to NAV: zero when NET trades at or below NAV, scaling linearly to a maximum of 0.45% per epoch at a 1.75× premium. This policy cannot be modified by governance. Refer to the NetNet mechanism docs for the full breakdown.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Zero-yield periods: Dividends are 0 whenever NET trades at or below NAV. Realised APY depends entirely on sustained market premium.
  • Dilution risk: Management holds a perpetually renewable option to mint up to 15% of circulating supply at 1 USDG per NET, creating ongoing NAV drag.
  • Counterparty risk: Up to 70% of reserves are deployed to Morpho — smart contract failures or liquidity events at Morpho could impact the backing.
  • Custody risk: The guardian key is controlled by a 1-of-1 Safe (management-controlled), not a multi-sig.
  • No governance escape hatch: The protocol cannot pause, patch bugs, or adjust parameters — formulas execute identically regardless of market conditions.

marketInfo.assetDescription:
superTSLA is a SuperVault from Superform that accumulates TSLAc — Coinbase's tokenised Tesla stock — over time.

The vault posts TSLAc as collateral in Aave V4's Equities Hub on Base, borrows USDC against it, and deploys that USDC through venues permitted by its mandate whenever the expected return clears borrowing costs, execution costs and a risk buffer. SuperformOS manages the loan-to-value ratio, debt, repayment and unwind programmatically. The yield is the spread that carry earns, and it accrues as more TSLAc behind each vault share rather than being paid out.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
• Leverage and liquidation risk: the strategy borrows USDC against TSLAc in Aave. A sharp fall in the collateral, or a failure of the automated LTV management, can force liquidations that cut the TSLAc backing each vault share.
  • Strategy risk: the borrowed USDC is deployed into third-party venues. The return is the spread between what those venues pay and the cost of the borrow, and that spread can compress or turn negative.

marketInfo.assetDescription: yGOOGLc (Dialectic Yielding GOOGLc) is a yield-bearing token from Makina, managed by Dialectic. Yield comes from a carry strategy. The strategy supplies GOOGLc as collateral on Aave V4 on Base, borrows USDC against it, and deploys the USDC into diversified stablecoin yield sources. Yield above the borrowing cost accrues to holders, who keep full exposure to the Alphabet share price.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
The exchange rate can fall if borrowing costs exceed the strategy yield, if the Aave position is liquidated after a sharp GOOGL price drop, or if the underlying strategy or protocols suffer losses, such as bad debt, a stablecoin depeg, or a smart contract or oracle failure.

(From Underlying Protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks:
Redemption goes through a queue of at least 3 days, and the payout is the lower of the value at request and at finalization. The exchange rate only updates on weekdays, so it stays flat over weekends.

GOOGLc is only available to eligible users outside the United States.https://makina.finance/strategy/ygooglc

marketInfo.assetDescription: hBTC is an ERC-4626 vault token issued by Syntetika for its BTC Basis+ strategy, a delta-neutral Bitcoin basis strategy managed by Hilbert Group. Yield accrues via the hBTC/cbBTC exchange rate as the strategy captures the spot–futures funding spread, options premium, and other BTC interest rate curve opportunities. Deposits and redemptions are processed on a twice-monthly NAV cycle.
marketInfo.riskInvolved:
Negative yield can occur when the underlying BTC Basis+ strategy is unprofitable during a given NAV update period. 6 of the 21 months since the fund's live track record began were negative months, with a max historical drawdown of 5.2%.

(From Underlying Protocol)
marketInfo.importantQuirks: Deposits and redemptions are fee-free but not instant - both go through a queue and are only processed on Syntetika's biweekly cycle (NAV updates roughly every 15 days).

deposit.description: Native minting available via Syntetika, subject to a queue - deposits are processed at the next biweekly NAV update.

withdrawal.description: Native withdrawal available via Syntetika, subject to a queue - redemptions are processed at the next biweekly NAV update (~15 days).

marketInfo.assetDescription:
apxUSD is a synthetic dollar issued by Apyx and backed by preferred shares of Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs), which generate off-chain dividend income to support the broader Apyx ecosystem. apxUSD itself does not accrue yield; instead, it functions as the protocol’s primary liquidity layer, designed to provide deep secondary market liquidity and broad integration across DeFi and CeFi venues.

The protocol also utilizes Protocol-Owned Liquidity (POL) as a liquidity buffer to help support apxUSD stability, particularly during periods of market stress. Dividend income from the underlying DAT preferred shares is not distributed to apxUSD holders, but is instead directed toward apyUSD, Apyx’s yield-bearing savings asset.
